text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: APIGW 5xx spike (502/504) observed across ingress clusters in us-west-1. Error rate up ~18% over baseline, multiple downstream timeouts. Auto-pager routed to oncall.
Mike (oncall): on it. pulling up dashboards now — thanks for the ping.
Anya (platform): seeing a sharp fanout in requests to /v1/generate from the mobile proxy, concurrent connections are 3x normal. latency p50/p95 both up.
Leo (runtime): looks like a spike in backend model pool saturating, kv-cache misses rising. Could be a recent rollout? Any new deploys in last 30m?
deploy-bot: deploy completed by @rachael at 3190001100 — service: mobile-proxy v1.3.8 -> v1.3.9, canary=100%.
Sam (edge): routing telemetry shows higher retry/forward rates at the edge layer; a subset of requests are getting 504 from apigw->upstream. Possibly sticky sessions hitting degraded upstream nodes.
Nora (SRE): can we short-circuit the proxy for high-volume health-check endpoints? also suggest enabling knockback / early-drop for heavy clients.
Mike (oncall): rolling back mobile-proxy to v1.3.8 to test. @deploy-bot please start rollback.
deploy-bot: rollback initiated to v1.3.8. ETA ~90s for pods to cycle.
Anya (platform): adding temporary circuit-breaker on model-pool: threshold=40s average latency, open window 30s. Patch applied to staging, promoting to prod in 60s.
Leo (runtime): if circuit opens we should also enable degraded-path fallback: serve cached embeddings or smaller-seq model variant to keep success rate. Pushing config now.
Sam (edge): moving some traffic away from us-west-1 to eu-west-1 as mitigation. Doing a 20% shift for 5m, monitor.
Mike (oncall): confirmed rollback finished, pod count stable. Initial error rate dropped to 12% (from 18%). continuing to watch.
Nora (SRE): also applied a short-term rate-limit for anonymous mobile clients (100 rps burst) to reduce noisy fans. config: 
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: RateLimit
spec:
  target: mobile-proxy
  key: client:anon
  limit: 100
  window: 1s
```

Anya (platform): dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/apigw/ingress-5xx (shortlink). p95 errors still elevated but trending down.
CS Bot: customer-impact: hitting ~3% active sessions experiencing errors in us-west-1; CS queued ten messages. No major outage yet but some users unable to create content.
Leo (runtime): logs showing upstream errors: 
```
[2026-03-15T12:07:22Z] upstream/ai-model: timeout after 45s; conn reset
[2026-03-15T12:07:23Z] kv-cache: miss for prefix xYz...; fallback to model inference
```

Sam (edge): CDN edge not the root cause. It's originating at apigw->upstream. Recommend keeping traffic shift until p95 errors < 2%.
Mike (oncall): agreed. keep rollback and shift for now. Nora, can you coordinate capacity bump on model-pool (add 4 instances) with ops?
Nora (SRE): on it — scaling group adjusted, provisioning GPU-backed instances. expected ready in ~4m.
Anya (platform): added temporary telemetry tag for session_ids for affected requests to help correlation.
Leo (runtime): after scale up and circuit-breaker, I expect error rate to drop under 2-3%. If not, we'll enable the aggressive fallback routing (route to quantized variant).
Mike (oncall): current metrics: error rate 7% and falling; latency p95 still high. customer impact trending down.
CS Bot: logged initial incident with CS ticket 34211, flagging accounts that hit rate >10% for follow-up.
deploy-bot: canary rollback audit: https://ci.redwood.ai/rollbacks/3190001234 (link).
Anya (platform): ETA for additional instances ~3m, circuit breaker is holding at partially open (30s window).
Nora (SRE): new instances online, health checks passing. load rebalanced across nodes.
Leo (runtime): observed KV cache warmup — miss rate decreasing, inference latency improving. p95 now ~2.1s (was 5.8s).
Sam (edge): holding traffic shift for another 10m, will revert gradually if stable.
Mike (oncall): excellent. marking this as mitigation in progress — paging should stop if errors <2% for next 10m. keep updates here.
Anya (platform): filing follow-up postmortem task: investigate why canary deploy reached 100% without rejecting the build when latency deviated. Assigning to @rachael and @leo.
Mike (oncall): thanks all. if anything regresses, re-open this thread. otherwise I'll close after stabilization window. :white_check_mark:
Nora (SRE): adding action items: scale playbook review, improved canary gating, knockback profiles documented.
incident-bot: Incident note recorded: INCIDENT-20260315-3190001234. Severity: P2 (customer impact moderate, mitigation active).
